When you open a book in an e-book app, it goes to the top of your reading list. Only book titles, authors, progress, due dates and covers on the shelf and search screens, and the title and progress on the reading screen, are read; book text and other apps are never seen. Turn on Pebble Desk in Accessibility.

Turn Pebble Desk off and on again in Accessibility.

This happens when BOOX freezes and unfreezes Pebble Desk. Turn off freezing for Pebble Desk in BOOX Settings › Apps and Notifications › Freeze Settings, then turn Pebble Desk off and on again in Accessibility.
Books you open in e-book apps won\'t be added, and reading time won\'t know which book it was. Turn on Pebble Desk in Accessibility.

If you allow reading book files, tapping the book on the home screen opens its file in Woojoo.

KOReader doesn\'t show book titles on screen, so the book you open and your progress are read from the records KOReader keeps (the koreader folder and the .sdr folder next to each book). For Readest, the cover, author and progress are read from its data folder (Readest/Books) once you move its data location to \u200B/\u2060sdcard\u2060/\u20600 (SD card: \u200B/\u2060sdcard\u2060/\u20601). For Woojoo, the book you open and your progress are known from the records Woojoo keeps (the Woojoo folder) without opening the menu, and PDFs and comics take their cover from there. For NeoReader, Moon+ Reader and Woojoo, covers are taken from the EPUB file of the book you open (EzViewer: the cover and book info). Only the title, author and cover are taken from book files.\n\nAllow Pebble Desk in Android\'s All files access. Nothing leaves the device.
Turn on Read\u00A0book\u00A0files to get %s book info

Reads only book titles, authors, progress, due dates and covers on the shelf and search screens (for EzViewer and CherieViewer, whose shelf is a file list, also file names and locations), and the title (file name for EzViewer and CherieViewer) and progress on the reading screen, of Kyobo Library, Kyobo eBook, Millie, Aladin, Bookers, Ridi, YES24 (Library, my YES, eBook), Moon+ Reader, EzViewer, CherieViewer, Kindle, Libby, NeoReader and KOReader to fill your reading list. Book text and other apps are not seen, and nothing leaves the device.
